name: recurse
description: Discover paid APIs and run private Python tools through Recurse. Inspect schemas and prices, set a spending cap, and retrieve stored results.

interface.longDescription: Use approved read APIs from agent-written Python tools, execute privately with an explicit spending cap, and read durable results and billing. Discover published tools and API schemas through 13 generic MCP operations. Requires the private-Tools-capable Recurse SDK and a Recurse account; the 0.2.6 SDK and this 0.4.0 package are unreleased TEST candidates.
defaultPrompt: Find a Recurse tool for my task and inspect its inputs and price.
Call an inspected Recurse tool within my spending allowance.
Check the stored result and charge for my Recurse call.
